description: Prove an agent's payment path still works end to end and keep proving it: a paid smoke test, a 402-envelope pre-flight, and a buyer-side trust probe of the seller you depend on. Use before going live, after changing a wallet or SDK, and as a weekly canary. Receipt verification is free.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent implement the requested change with minimal unrelated edits?
Did the agent verify behavior changes instead of relying on intuition?
